nodes.description: Mapping address => uint256 storing token balances; written by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping owner => spender => uint256 allowance; written by approve and approveAndCall, decremented by transferFrom.
Public total token supply, set in the ERC20Token constructor to 100000000000.
Public token name string, set to 'NFT Marketplace DCART' in the constructor.
Public uint8 decimals value, set to 4 in the constructor.
Public token symbol string, set to 'DCART' in the constructor.
Public version string initialized to 'v1.0'.
Internal owner address assigned from msg.sender in the constructor; never used afterwards.
Interface declaration of totalSupply() returning uint256 supply; unimplemented in Token.
Constant function returning balances[_owner].
Transfers _value from msg.sender to _to; performs unchecked balance subtraction and addition.
Transfers _value from _from to _to using allowance of msg.sender; unchecked arithmetic on balances and allowed.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval; no zero-allowance or race protection.
Constant function returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Fallback function that throws on any plain ether transfer to the contract.
Constructor initializing balances[msg.sender], totalSupply, name, decimals, symbol and owner.
Sets allowance then performs an external _spender.call to receiveApproval, reverting on failure.
Caller-controlled address used as the balance owner, allowance owner and contract owner.
balances[msg.sender] -= _value; unchecked subtraction in transfer.
balances[_to] += _value; unchecked addition in transfer.
balances[_to] += _value; unchecked addition in transferFrom.
balances[_from] -= _value; unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value; unchecked subtraction of the allowance.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value; unconditional allowance overwrite enabling the approve race.
_spender.call(receiveApproval selector, ...) external call with attacker-controlled target and data.
Parameter _value of StandardToken.transfer (amount to move).
Parameter _to of StandardToken.transfer (recipient address).
Parameter _from of StandardToken.transferFrom (source address).
Parameter _to of StandardToken.transferFrom (recipient address).
Parameter _value of StandardToken.transferFrom (amount to move).
Parameter _owner of StandardToken.balanceOf.
Parameter _spender of StandardToken.approve.
Parameter _value of StandardToken.approve (allowance amount).
Parameter _owner of StandardToken.allowance.
Parameter _spender of StandardToken.allowance.
Parameter _spender of ERC20Token.approveAndCall, also the external call target.
Parameter _value of ERC20Token.approveAndCall.
Parameter _extraData of ERC20Token.approveAndCall, forwarded verbatim to the external call.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the key for the sender balance in transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender key in allowed[_from][msg.sender] within transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key in approve.
msg.sender receives the entire initial supply and becomes owner in the constructor.
msg.sender is forwarded to the callee as the approver in approveAndCall.
msg.sender indexes the allowance being decremented in transferFrom.
User-supplied _value is subtracted from balances[msg.sender] without a safe-math check.
User-supplied _value is added to balances[_to] without overflow protection.
Attacker-controlled _to selects the balance slot that is credited in transfer.
_from selects the balance slot debited by _value in transferFrom.
_from selects the allowance slot decremented in transferFrom.
_to selects the recipient balance credited in transferFrom.
User-supplied _value is added to balances[_to] in transferFrom without overflow protection.
User-supplied _value is subtracted from balances[_from] in transferFrom.
User-supplied _value is subtracted from the allowance in transferFrom.
_spender chooses who receives the allowance written in approve.
_value is written directly into allowed[msg.sender][_spender], overwriting any existing allowance.
_spender is the target of the external .call, allowing an attacker-controlled contract to be invoked.
_value is passed into the external receiveApproval call.
_extraData is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping to return the queried balance.
allowance reads the allowed mapping to return the remaining spender allowance.
_owner selects the balance slot read by balanceOf.
_owner selects the allowance owner read by allowance.
_spender selects the allowance spender read by allowance.
transfer executes the unchecked sender balance subtraction.
transfer executes the unchecked recipient balance addition.
transferFrom executes the unchecked recipient balance addition.
transferFrom executes the unchecked source balance subtraction.
transferFrom executes the unchecked allowance subtraction.
approve performs the unconditional allowance overwrite.
approveAndCall reaches the raw external .call after mutating the allowance.
The external .call can re-enter approveAndCall or other token entry points before state is settled.

normalization_plan.reason: transfer._value is a parameter whose only role is flowing into transfer's balance updates.
transfer._to is a parameter whose only role is selecting the credited slot in transfer.
transferFrom._from is a parameter used only inside transferFrom's balance and allowance updates.
transferFrom._to is a parameter used only to credit a balance inside transferFrom.
transferFrom._value is a parameter feeding all three unchecked arithmetic operations in transferFrom.
balanceOf._owner is a parameter used only to read balances in balanceOf.
approve._spender is a parameter used only to write the allowance in approve.
approve._value is a parameter written into the allowance in approve.
allowance._owner is a parameter used only to read allowed in allowance.
allowance._spender is a parameter used only to read allowed in allowance.
approveAndCall._spender is a parameter that becomes the external call target in approveAndCall.
approveAndCall._value is a parameter written to allowance and forwarded to the external call.
approveAndCall._extraData is a parameter forwarded verbatim to the external call.
